Definition: a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum
BiblicalUsage: 1) sacred place, sanctuary, holy place; 1a) sanctuary; 1a1) of the temple; 1a2) of the tabernacle; 1a3) of Ezekiel's temple; 1a4) of Jehovah
